answer.waiting: Revision {revision} waits for their yes since {date}: it is listed in Waiting on {customer}.
answer.notAsked: Revision {revision} needs their yes, but it was never asked: ask {customer} now.
answer.expired: Revision {revision} needs their yes, and the ask expired: ask {customer} again.
answer.sendNew: The order changed after v{version} was sent.
answer.notSent: Make it and send it in Our confirmation below.
answer.notSentNoPrice: Not sent yet: someone who sees prices makes and sends it.

signed.missing: We can't find the PDF they signed
signed.unchecked: We can't check the signed PDF

agreement.noWithdrawal: Made to measure: no right of withdrawal, accepted on the quote.
agreement.portal: Placed in the portal as {number} on {date}
agreement.portalBy: Placed in the portal by {name} as {number} on {date}

revision.waiting: Revision {revision}: asked, waiting for their yes since {date}
revision.notAsked: Revision {revision}: their yes was never asked
revision.expired: Revision {revision}: the ask expired without an answer

agreement.noPrice: The confirmation shows prices: someone who sees prices sends it.
agreement.sendsListed: Every send is listed in What changed › Confirmations.
agreement.signedPriced: The signed PDF shows prices: someone who sees prices opens it.

ask.title: Ask {customer} to re-confirm revision {revision}?
ask.body: {customer} gets a task in its portal and, with an e-mail address on file, an e-mail: “Re-confirm the revised order {number}”. They answer with their typed name.
ask.portalOnly: No e-mail address on file: asked in {customer}'s portal only
ask.until: Until they answer, the row waits under Waiting on {customer}.
ask.doneEmail: Asked {customer}: an e-mail went to {email}, and the task is in its portal.
ask.donePortal: Asked in {customer}'s portal: no e-mail address on file.

history.title: What changed
history.info: Every change since the order was confirmed, one row each: what changed and why, the customer's answer, what it did on the floor, who and when. The chips filter the list (a row may be in two); Before → after shows the change line by line.
history.empty: No changes since the order was confirmed.
history.emptyFinal: No changes before the order was closed.

emptyChip.all: No changes since the order was confirmed.
emptyChip.requests: No customer requests on this order.
emptyChip.workOrders: No work-order changes on this order.

history.whyPutBackAny: Restores an earlier revision as before
history.sent: Confirmation v{version} sent to the customer
history.woDraft: The floor was not told: {number} is a draft

compare.gone: This change is not in the order's list any more.
compare.headerLabel: The order's details before and after
compare.noPrice: Not shown to you: the amounts (people who see prices see them).

saved.plainPortal: Saved · asked in {customer}'s portal: no e-mail address on file.
saved.changedPortal: Saved · {changed} changed · asked in {customer}'s portal: no e-mail address on file.
saved.waitsEmail: Saved · waiting for production: {waits} — decide on this page · asked {customer} by e-mail.
saved.waitsPortal: Saved · waiting for production: {waits} — decide on this page · asked in {customer}'s portal: no e-mail address on file.
saved.bothEmail: Saved · {changed} changed · waiting for production: {waits} — decide on this page · asked {customer} by e-mail.
saved.bothPortal: Saved · {changed} changed · waiting for production: {waits} — decide on this page · asked in {customer}'s portal: no e-mail address on file.
saved.askedAlready: {customer} is asked already: the ask waits under Waiting on {customer}.

head.wallPrice: Amounts are shown to people who see prices.
head.closed: The order is closed: its money plan no longer changes.
head.cancelled: the order is cancelled: nothing more is owed
head.depositMissing: a deposit is needed and was never asked
head.extraOpenFromWords: an extra deposit is open (change rev {revision})
head.balanceBeforeShipping: the balance is due before shipping
head.invoicesOpen: the invoices are not paid in full
head.nothing: nothing to collect yet. The customer pays on the invoice
head.nothingTerms: nothing to collect yet. The customer pays on the invoice: {terms}
head.restOnInvoice: the rest is paid on the invoice
head.partFailed: Part of the money could not be read: see the section below and try it again there.

totals.title: Totals
totals.info: What the order is worth, what came in, what is left, and what is still missing before it is settled. No total is ever typed: a person changes the cause (a line, a payment, a credit note, a write-off). “Invoiced” and “Paid” open their sections.
totals.keys: Keys: Tab moves from tile to tile · Enter opens one.
totals.settledRow: Shipped, invoiced, every document delivered by SDI, and paid.

adds.title: How it adds up
adds.freight: Freight on the invoices, in no order

fact.paidExtraWords: Paid · an extra deposit is open

payments.title: Payments
payments.info: The plan of what the customer pays and when. The deposit is its first step; a step that asks money carries its request: its steps and its payments are inside the row. What was replaced or removed stays under Earlier steps.
payments.keys: Keys: Tab moves from row to row · Enter opens the row's act · Space unfolds a row.
payments.earlierHint: replaced or removed; kept with who, when and why

plan.label: {label}
plan.title: {kind} · {share}

due.notOwed: Not owed: the order is cancelled

note.extraWaits: New work orders wait for it; released ones keep running
note.holdsShipment: Holds the shipment until it is paid
note.paidWithInvoice: Paid when the goods' invoice is paid
note.owedOnInvoice: {amount} stays owed and goes on the final invoice
note.owedOnInvoiceWords: The missing part stays owed and goes on the final invoice

answer.none: nothing is open yet: the customer pays on the invoice
answer.final: the order is closed: its plan no longer changes
answer.cancelled: nothing is owed: the order is cancelled

held.moneyPlaced: Money is placed on it: undo the payment first.
held.onlyStep: The only step takes the whole order: add a step first.
held.dayFromInvoice: Its day comes from the invoice.
held.final: The order is closed: its plan no longer changes.
held.nothingFree: Every step has money on it already: there is no open step to take it from.

plan.shortHint: {amount} short: banks often keep a fee on a transfer. Accept it as bank charges, or ask the customer for the rest.

invoices.title: Invoices & credit notes
invoices.empty: Nothing invoiced yet: the deposit invoice and the invoices of shipped goods appear here.
invoices.info: Every bill of this order — goods invoices, deposit invoices and credit notes — where it stands and what is still to pay. Each ⋯ opens Finance's own window. An issued invoice never changes: a credit note corrects it.
invoices.keys: Keys: Tab moves from row to row · Enter opens the number.

held.creditNote: A credit note is corrected by a debit note.

hand.whyHint: Required · office only · kept in the history with who and when.
hand.who: Saved under your name with today's date; the row is tagged “Set by hand”; the history keeps the old value.
hand.whoCode: Saved under your name with today's date; the history keeps the old value. You confirm with a fresh code from your authenticator app.

ba.title: Before → after
ba.reading: Reading the plan as it would be…
ba.failed: The plan as it would be could not be read: the act still goes, and the server checks it.
ba.waits: The plan as it would be shows here once the act and its reason are typed.

problem.reasonShort: Say why in at least 3 characters.
problem.share: Type a share of the order total (25 %) or an amount (3.050,00).
problem.past: Pick today or a later day.
problem.gone: This step or request is not on the plan any more: close the window and read the page again.
problem.from: Pick the step it is taken from.
problem.restTo: Pick the step that takes the rest.
problem.label: Type a name.
problem.termsSame: The order has these payment terms already.

field.shareHint: A share of the order total (25 %) or an amount (3.050,00).
field.dayOptional: Optional · a deposit or a step before shipping asks it when it is opened.
field.label: Name
field.labelHint: Optional · printed on its request page.
field.termsFailed: The payment terms could not be read: close the window and try again.

REPLACE_DEPOSIT.title: Change the deposit of {number}

happens.replaced: The deposit asked now is kept as Replaced, under Earlier steps.
happens.asked: A new deposit is asked for the share or amount you type; the open steps take the rest, so the plan still adds up.
happens.waits: Production still waits for the deposit.

REPLACE_DEPOSIT.told: A bank-details page sent before stops working: send the new page to the customer.
REPLACE_DEPOSIT.never: A deposit's amount is never edited: the old request stays as it was, with its own history. The deposit invoice (TD02) is made only when money arrives.

MOVE_DUE.title: Move the due day · {row}

happens.together: The step and its payment request move together.
happens.overdue: Overdue is worked out again from the new day.

MOVE_DUE.toldLive: the live bank-details page shows the new day by itself; no e-mail is sent.
MOVE_DUE.toldNone: no page was sent for it, so the customer is not told.
MOVE_DUE.never: A paid step's day never moves. The amount does not change here.

ASK_AGAIN.title: Ask again · {row}

happens.asked: A new payment request of the same amount is asked; the waived one stays as it was.
happens.waits: Production waits for the deposit again; released work orders keep running.

ASK_AGAIN.holds: It holds the shipment again until it is paid.
ASK_AGAIN.told: the customer sees it when its bank-details page is sent.
ASK_AGAIN.never: The waived step and its reason stay in the history.

ADD_STEP.title: Add a step to the plan of {number}

happens.taken: The amount comes out of the step you pick: the plan still adds up to the order total.
happens.request: A deposit or a step before shipping gets its own payment request: it may hold production or the shipment.

ADD_STEP.told: the customer sees the step when its bank-details page is sent.
ADD_STEP.never: Paid steps keep their amount; the order total does not change.

CHANGE_STEP.title: Change the amount · {row}

happens.rest: The difference goes to the step you pick, so the plan still adds up.
happens.request: A step whose payment request is not paid yet gets a new request (an amount is never edited).

CHANGE_STEP.told: a live page of the old request stops working: send the new one.
CHANGE_STEP.never: Paid steps and the order total do not change.

REMOVE_STEP.title: Remove the step · {row}

happens.earlier: The step goes under Earlier steps, with who, when and why.
happens.rest: Its amount goes to the step you pick; an unpaid request of it is cancelled.
happens.noDeposit: It is the order's deposit: production no longer waits for a deposit.

REMOVE_STEP.told: a live page of it stops working.
REMOVE_STEP.never: A step with money on it is never removed.

RENAME_STEP.title: Rename · {row}

happens.printed: The new name is printed on its request page and its documents.

RENAME_STEP.told: the customer reads the new name on its page.
RENAME_STEP.never: Its amount and its day do not change.

UNDO_OPEN.title: Undo the opening · {row}

happens.cancelled: Its payment request (nothing paid on it) is cancelled; the step stays, with no request.
happens.shipment: It no longer holds the shipment until it is opened again.

UNDO_OPEN.told: a live page of it stops working.
UNDO_OPEN.never: The step itself and its amount stay.

CHANGE_TERMS.title: Change the payment terms of {number}

happens.remade: Only open steps are remade; paid, part-paid and deposit steps, and the steps set by hand, stay.
happens.total: The order's total does not change.

CHANGE_TERMS.told: sees the new plan in their portal at once; send a new confirmation version from Changes › Customer's agreement. No new yes is asked.
CHANGE_TERMS.never: Paid steps, an issued deposit invoice and the order total never change.

ACCEPT_SHORT.title: Accept the deposit {amount} short?

happens.paid: The deposit counts as paid: production may start.
happens.owed: The missing part stays owed and goes on the final invoice, where Finance may write it off.
happens.td02: Its deposit invoice (TD02) stays as it is: the amount paid.

ACCEPT_SHORT.told: not told; their portal shows the deposit as paid.
ACCEPT_SHORT.never: The payment stays as received; no write-off is made here; the deposit stays paid (this cannot be undone).

hand.whoKept: Saved under your name with today's date; the history keeps it.

refusal.OTHER: The plan could not change this way: read the page again.
refusal.MOVED: The plan changed meanwhile: it was read again.
refusal.FORBIDDEN: Changing the money plan needs its right: your role changed meanwhile.

stepUp.plan: Changing the money plan this way asks a fresh code from your authenticator app.
stepUp.terms: Changing the payment terms asks a fresh code from your authenticator app.

notice.planChanged: The plan was changed by hand; the history keeps the old value.
notice.undone: The payment was undone; it stays in Finance › Payments as voided.
notice.priceAccepted: The price difference is accepted by hand.
notice.priceUnaccepted: The acceptance is undone: the prices are compared again.
notice.costLineAdded: The cost set by hand is counted in the margin.
notice.costLineRemoved: The line set by hand is put back: the computed cost counts again.
notice.targetCleared: The target margin is cleared: the floor applies again.

undo.title: Undo the payment of {date}?

happens.reversed: The payment is taken off this request and, when it then pays nothing else, voided — in one step.
happens.open: The deposit goes back to Open.
happens.production: Production keeps waiting for the deposit; released work orders keep running.

undo.told: not e-mailed; their portal shows the deposit open again.
undo.never: The payment is never deleted: it stays in Finance › Payments, voided, with your reason.

lock.label: Why it goes into a closed month
lock.hint: This month is closed softly in the books: say why it goes in anyway (3 to 500 characters).
lock.problem: Say why it goes into the closed month (3 to 500 characters).

link.contactHint: The customer's active contacts with an e-mail address.

price.title: Price check
price.info: Our price beside the customer's own price (their PO, their portal, or typed by us), line by line, without VAT, to the cent. It is not a price-list check. A difference accepted by hand opens again by itself when either price changes.
price.keys: Keys: Tab moves line to line · Enter uses the button.
price.onlyDiffering: Show only the lines that differ
price.exact: Without VAT, exact to the cent. Difference = our price minus the customer's.

answer.none: type the prices from their PO, or they type them in their portal.

accept.title: Accept the difference on {number}

happens.stay: Both prices stay as they are.
happens.shows: The check shows “≠ Not equal · Accepted by hand”, with your name, the day and your reason.
happens.reopens: It opens again by itself when either price changes.

accept.told: not told: their portal still compares against their own PO.
accept.never: Our price and the customer's price are not edited; nothing is sent.
accept.gone: The prices changed meanwhile: close the window and read the check again.

happens.again: The check shows “≠ Not equal” again.
happens.kept: The history keeps the acceptance and its reason.

margin.title: Margin
margin.info: Does this order still make the money we planned, and if not, why? At quote = as sold · Now = the estimate · Actual so far = the costs posted. A margin is never typed: set a cost by hand, with a reason; Put back removes it.
margin.keys: Keys: Tab moves from part to part · Enter opens a fold.

basedOn.quote: Based on: the cost at quote
basedOn.none: Based on: no cost sheet behind the quote
basedOn.both: Based on: cost at quote {date} · rev {revision}

margin.final: The order is closed: its margin is final.

held.final: The order is closed: its margin is final.

tile.noQuotedCost: No cost at quote: a line had no cost sheet
tile.noWorkOrder: No work order yet: now = the cost at quote
tile.actualFinal: Final: every work order is done
tile.actualOpen: Reads high while work is open

meter.label: Margin now
meter.belowFloor: flagged: below the margin it is held to

hand.adds: adds a line to the computed cost

putBack.title: Put back · {what}
putBack.gone: This line is not counted any more: close the window and read the margin again.

happens.removed: Your line no longer counts in Now and Actual so far.
happens.computed: The computed cost alone counts again.

putBack.never: The history keeps your line, its amount and its reason.

bridge.title: From the price to the margin
bridge.noFreightSet: Freight: none yet — set an estimate by hand
bridge.noCost: Shown to people who see costs.

why.method: Costs follow the company's costing method.
why.provisional: Costs are provisional until the accountant chooses the costing method.
why.freightCounted: Freight from the shipments is counted (in the order's currency only).
why.freightNone: No freight cost is on the order's shipments yet: before a shipment, set an estimate by hand.
why.hand: A cost set by hand is added to the computed cost; Put back removes it. A margin is never typed.
why.bankCharges: Bank charges written off on payments are not in the margin yet (a later job).

setCost.title: Set a cost by hand · {number}
setCost.kindHint: A line ADDED to the computed cost; replacing a computed part comes later.
setCost.problem: Type an amount above 0, for example 320.00.

happens.uses: Now and Actual so far use your figure; At quote stays as sold.
happens.beside: The computed cost stays beside it; Put back removes your line.

setCost.never: The quote's cost, the posted cost ledger and approved cost sheets never change here.

target.title: Set the target margin of {number}
target.hint: Empty: no target of its own; the floor of the Sales settings applies.
target.hintFloor: Empty: no target of its own; the floor applies ({pct}).
target.problem: Type a percent above 0 and below 100, for example 38.5.

happens.marks: The meter marks it; the order is judged on it, not on the floor.
happens.flag: Below it, the order is flagged in Finance › Margins.

target.never: The margin itself is never typed: it stays worked out from the price and the costs.

margin.who: Saved under your name with today's date; the history keeps the old value.

stop.title: Stop the page sent to {to}?
stop.gone: This page is not live any more: close the window and read the page again.

happens.stops: The bank-details page stops working at once: the customer sees that it is no longer valid.
happens.open: The payment request stays open: send a new page when it is needed.

stop.told: not e-mailed; the page itself says it is no longer valid.
stop.never: The request, its amount and its payments do not change.
